paper: Empirical Asset Pricing with Large Language Model Agents
headline_strategy: AAPM hybrid asset-pricing model: iteratively refine stock-specific and macro reports from retrieved WSJ news with an LLM, embed the reports, combine them with asset embeddings and manual financial factors in a historically pretrained pricing network, predict returns, and form TP/EW/VW long-short portfolios

paper_configuration.v1_split: 9 months training, 3 months validation, 1 year test

paper_portability_to_common_task: not defensibly executable because the release has components but no training path, paper inputs, trained weights, predictions, or portfolio implementation
missing_headline_objects: the filtered WSJ article bodies and derived Tickers, Topics, and Content records
CRSP daily returns, Jensen-et-al. characteristic inputs, imputation, and mappings
generated report embeddings and continuously updated macro-note outputs
historical-factor pretraining code, training entrypoint, sweep history, and trained checkpoint
v2 GPT-4o/O1 request-response traces, exact generation settings, and parser
native return predictions, decile assignments, portfolio returns, baselines, and result arrays
TP/EW/VW long-short portfolio and asset-pricing test implementation
material_source_conflicts: Model.forward combines report and asset embeddings but never consumes the paper's manual financial factors.
The macro note stores a formatted update instruction rather than an LLM response.
The SKIP path returns three values while its caller expects four.
Model.eval does not switch dropout and BatchNorm into evaluation mode, and the best-checkpoint path loads the periodic/latest checkpoint.
The current source still defaults to GPT-3.5-Turbo-1106 and is unchanged from paper-era code except README, so v2 model/result lineage is absent.

rejected_substitutes.route: Run the released model-forward fixture as a strategy
rejected_substitutes.reason: It uses controlled supplied embeddings and random 49-parameter weights; it is not trained and omits manual factors.
It contains dates and paths only; every article body and required Tickers/Topics/Content field is absent.
This preserves only one input family while removing the LLM news-retrieval/refinement and hybrid historical-pretraining mechanism.

rejected_substitutes.route: Generate synthetic reports or call a modern LLM
rejected_substitutes.reason: Without the point-in-time WSJ corpus, requests, parser, training target and trained network, this would create a new strategy rather than an accessible-model substitution.

rejected_substitutes.route: Transcribe paper deciles or displayed portfolio statistics
rejected_substitutes.reason: Published figures and table cells are outputs, not formation-time scores or holdings.

result_policy: No random model output, metadata-only index, JKP-only factor model, synthetic report, or displayed paper result is entered as an AAPM return. The positive performance claims remain unresolved rather than classified as false or as JKP underperformance.
